qEn: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following is an example of security in the AWS Cloud?
qZh: 在 AWS 責任共擔模型下，下列哪一項是「雲端內部 (in the AWS Cloud)」安全的範例？
expEn: The customer is responsible for 'Security IN the Cloud', which includes configuring and managing network firewalls (like AWS Security Groups and Network ACLs). The other options are AWS's responsibility ('Security OF the Cloud').
expZh: 客戶負責「雲端內部的安全」，其中包括設定和管理網路防火牆（例如 AWS 安全群組和網路 ACL）。其他選項是 AWS 的責任（「雲端本身的安全」）。

qEn: How can an AWS user with an AWS Basic Support plan obtain technical assistance from AWS?
qZh: 擁有 AWS 基本支援計畫的 AWS 使用者如何獲得來自 AWS 的技術協助？
expEn: The Basic Support plan does not include technical support from AWS engineers (no email, phone, or chat). Users on the Basic plan can seek help from the community via the AWS Discussion Forums.
expZh: 基本支援計畫不包含來自 AWS 工程師的技術支援（沒有電子郵件、電話或聊天）。基本計畫的使用者可以透過 AWS 討論區向社群尋求協助。

qEn: Which of the following are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Choose two.)
qZh: 下列哪些是 AWS 良好架構框架 (Well-Architected Framework) 的支柱？（選擇兩個）
expEn: The AWS Well-Architected Framework is built on six pillars: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability.
expZh: AWS 良好架構框架建立在六個支柱之上：卓越營運、安全性、可靠性、效能效率、成本優化和永續性。

qEn: After selecting an Amazon EC2 Dedicated Host reservation, which pricing option would provide the largest discount?
qZh: 選擇 Amazon EC2 專用主機預留後，哪個定價選項將提供最大的折扣？
optionsZh: 按小時計費的按需付款
expEn: When purchasing any AWS reservation (like EC2 Reserved Instances or Dedicated Host Reservations), the 'All Upfront' payment option always provides the largest discount compared to Partial Upfront or No Upfront.
expZh: 在購買任何 AWS 預留（如 EC2 預留執行個體或專用主機預留）時，與「部分預付」或「無預付」相比，「全額預付」付款選項總是能提供最大的折扣。

qEn: What is an advantage of deploying an application across multiple Availability Zones?
qZh: 跨多個可用區域部署應用程式的優勢是什麼？
optionsEn: There is a lower risk of service failure if a natural disaster causes a service disruption in a given AWS Region.
The application will have higher availability because it can withstand a service disruption in one Availability Zone.
There will be better coverage as Availability Zones are geographically distant and can serve a wider area.
There will be decreased application latency that will improve the user experience.
optionsZh: 如果自然災害導致特定 AWS 區域的服務中斷，服務失敗的風險較低。
應用程式將具有更高的可用性，因為它可以承受一個可用區域的服務中斷。
將會有更好的覆蓋範圍，因為可用區域在地理上相距遙遠，可以服務更廣泛的區域。
將會降低應用程式延遲，從而改善使用者體驗。
expEn: Availability Zones are physically separated and isolated data centers within a single Region. Deploying across multiple AZs ensures high availability because if one AZ fails, the application remains operational in the other AZ.
expZh: 可用區域是單一區域內實體分離且隔離的資料中心。跨多個 AZ 部署可確保高可用性，因為如果一個 AZ 發生故障，應用程式在其他 AZ 中仍可繼續運作。

qEn: A Cloud Practitioner is asked how to estimate the cost of using a new application on AWS. What is the MOST appropriate response?
qZh: 有人詢問雲端從業者如何估算在 AWS 上使用新應用程式的成本。最合適的回應是什麼？
optionsEn: Inform the user that AWS pricing allows for on-demand pricing.
Direct the user to the AWS Simple Monthly Calculator for an estimate.
Use Amazon QuickSight to analyze current spending on-premises.
Use Amazon AppStream 2.0 for real-time pricing analytics.
optionsZh: 告知使用者 AWS 定價允許按需定價。
引導使用者使用 AWS 簡單每月計算機 (AWS Simple Monthly Calculator / Pricing Calculator) 進行估算。
使用 Amazon QuickSight 分析目前在本地端的支出。
使用 Amazon AppStream 2.0 進行即時定價分析。
expEn: The AWS Simple Monthly Calculator (now replaced by the AWS Pricing Calculator) is the appropriate tool for estimating the anticipated monthly cost of a *new* architecture or application on AWS.
expZh: AWS 簡單每月計算機（現已被 AWS 定價計算機取代）是用於估算 AWS 上「新」架構或應用程式預期每月成本的適當工具。

qEn: A company wants to migrate its applications to a VPC on AWS. These applications will need to access on-premises resources. What combination of actions will enable the company to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)
qZh: 一家公司希望將其應用程式遷移到 AWS 上的 VPC。這些應用程式將需要存取本地端資源。哪些動作組合將使公司能達成此目標？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Use the AWS Service Catalog to identify a list of on-premises resources that can be migrated.
Build a VPN connection between an on-premises device and a virtual private gateway in the new VPC.
Use Amazon Athena to query data from the on-premises database servers.
Connect the company's on-premises data center to AWS using AWS Direct Connect.
Leverage Amazon CloudFront to restrict access to static web content provided through the company's on-premises web servers.
optionsZh: 使用 AWS Service Catalog 識別可遷移的本地資源清單。
在本地設備與新 VPC 中的虛擬私有閘道之間建立 VPN 連線。
使用 Amazon Athena 查詢來自本地資料庫伺服器的資料。
使用 AWS Direct Connect 將公司的本地資料中心連線至 AWS。
利用 Amazon CloudFront 限制對公司本地 Web 伺服器提供的靜態 Web 內容的存取。
expEn: To connect an AWS VPC securely to an on-premises data center, you can establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN (using a virtual private gateway) or set up a dedicated physical connection using AWS Direct Connect.
expZh: 要將 AWS VPC 安全地連接到本地資料中心，您可以建立 AWS Site-to-Site VPN（使用虛擬私有閘道）或使用 AWS Direct Connect 設定專用的實體連線。

qEn: A web application running on AWS has been spammed with malicious requests from a recurring set of IP addresses. Which AWS service can help secure the application and block the malicious traffic?
qZh: 一個在 AWS 上執行的 Web 應用程式遭到一組重複出現的 IP 位址發送惡意請求的垃圾郵件攻擊。哪項 AWS 服務可以協助保護應用程式並阻擋惡意流量？
expEn: AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) allows you to create custom rules to block or allow HTTP/HTTPS traffic based on conditions like IP addresses, thereby securing your web application against malicious spammers.
expZh: AWS WAF (Web 應用程式防火牆) 允許您建立自訂規則，根據 IP 位址等條件阻擋或允許 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，從而保護您的 Web 應用程式免受惡意垃圾郵件攻擊。

qEn: Treating infrastructure as code in the AWS Cloud allows users to:
qZh: 在 AWS 雲端中將基礎架構視為程式碼 (infrastructure as code) 允許使用者：
optionsEn: automate migration of on-premises hardware to AWS data centers.
let a third party automate an audit of the AWS infrastructure.
turn over application code to AWS so it can run on the AWS infrastructure.
optionsZh: 自動將本地硬體遷移到 AWS 資料中心。
讓第三方自動稽核 AWS 基礎架構。
將應用程式碼移交給 AWS，以便在 AWS 基礎架構上執行。
自動化基礎架構的佈建過程。
expEn: Infrastructure as Code (IaC), facilitated by tools like AWS CloudFormation, allows you to write scripts (templates) that automatically and consistently provision and manage your cloud infrastructure.
expZh: 由 AWS CloudFormation 等工具促進的基礎架構即程式碼 (IaC)，允許您編寫指令碼（範本），自動且一致地配置和管理您的雲端基礎架構。

qEn: A company requires a dedicated network connection between its on-premises servers and the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service should be used?
qZh: 一家公司需要在其本地伺服器和 AWS 雲端之間建立專用的網路連線。應使用哪項 AWS 服務？
expEn: AWS Direct Connect lets you establish a dedicated, private physical network connection from your premises to AWS, bypassing the public internet.
expZh: AWS Direct Connect 讓您能從您的本地端到 AWS 建立專用的私有實體網路連線，繞過公共網際網路。

qEn: Which AWS service can be used to query stored datasets directly from Amazon S3 using standard SQL?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務可用於使用標準 SQL 直接從 Amazon S3 查詢儲存的資料集？
expEn: Amazon Athena is an interactive, serverless query service that makes it easy to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL.
expZh: Amazon Athena 是一種互動式的無伺服器查詢服務，讓您能使用標準 SQL 輕鬆地直接在 Amazon S3 中分析資料。

qEn: AWS CloudFormation is designed to help the user:
qZh: AWS CloudFormation 旨在協助使用者：
optionsZh: 建立模型並配置資源 (model and provision resources)。
expEn: AWS CloudFormation allows you to use a common language (JSON/YAML templates) to model and automatically provision all the infrastructure resources needed for your applications across all regions and accounts.
expZh: AWS CloudFormation 允許您使用通用語言（JSON/YAML 範本）為您的應用程式在所有區域和帳戶中建立模型並自動配置所有必要的基礎架構資源。

qEn: Which of the following is an AWS database service?
qZh: 下列哪一項是 AWS 資料庫服務？
expEn: Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse service, which falls under the Database/Analytics category. EBS, Glacier, and Snowball are storage and data transfer services.
expZh: Amazon Redshift 是一種全託管、PB 級的雲端資料倉儲服務，屬於資料庫/分析類別。EBS、Glacier 和 Snowball 是儲存和資料傳輸服務。

qEn: A Cloud Practitioner must determine if any security groups in an AWS account have been provisioned to allow unrestricted access for specific ports. What is the SIMPLEST way to do this?
qZh: 雲端從業者 (Cloud Practitioner) 必須確定 AWS 帳戶中是否有任何安全群組已被配置為允許對特定連接埠的無限制存取。最簡單 (SIMPLEST) 的方法是什麼？
optionsEn: Review the inbound rules for each security group in the Amazon EC2 management console to check for port 0.0.0.0/0.
Run AWS Trusted Advisor and review the findings.
Open the AWS IAM console and check the inbound rule filters for open access.
In AWS Config, create a custom rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function to review rules for inbound access.
optionsZh: 在 Amazon EC2 管理控制台中檢查每個安全群組的入站規則，以尋找連接埠 0.0.0.0/0。
執行 AWS Trusted Advisor 並檢視結果。
開啟 AWS IAM 控制台並檢查入站規則過濾器以尋找開放存取。
在 AWS Config 中，建立一個叫用 AWS Lambda 函數的自訂規則，以審查入站存取的規則。
expEn: AWS Trusted Advisor includes a core security check called 'Security Groups - Specific Ports Unrestricted' that automatically flags security groups that allow unrestricted access (0.0.0.0/0) to certain ports.
expZh: AWS Trusted Advisor 包含一個名為「安全群組 - 特定連接埠未受限制」的核心安全檢查，它會自動標記允許無限制存取 (0.0.0.0/0) 某些連接埠的安全群組。

qEn: What are the benefits of developing and running a new application in the AWS Cloud compared to on-premises? (Choose two.)
qZh: 與本地端相比，在 AWS 雲端中開發和執行新應用程式的好處是什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: AWS automatically distributes the data globally for higher durability.
AWS will take care of operating the application.
AWS makes it easy to architect for high availability.
AWS can easily accommodate application demand changes.
AWS takes care application security patching.
optionsZh: AWS 會自動在全球發布資料以提高耐久性。
AWS 將負責營運該應用程式。
AWS 讓高可用性架構設計變得容易。
AWS 能輕鬆適應應用程式需求變化。
AWS 負責應用程式安全修補。
expEn: AWS provides tools (like multiple Availability Zones and ELB) that make architecting for high availability easy. AWS also provides elasticity (Auto Scaling), allowing applications to easily accommodate fluctuating demand.
expZh: AWS 提供工具（如多個可用區域和 ELB），讓高可用性架構設計變得容易。AWS 還提供彈性 (Auto Scaling)，允許應用程式輕鬆適應波動的需求。

qEn: A user needs an automated security assessment report that will identify unintended network access to Amazon EC2 instances and vulnerabilities on those instances. Which AWS service will provide this assessment report?
qZh: 使用者需要一份自動化的安全評估報告，該報告能識別對 Amazon EC2 執行個體的非預期網路存取以及這些執行個體上的漏洞。哪項 AWS 服務將提供此評估報告？
expEn: Amazon Inspector is an automated security assessment service that helps improve the security and compliance of applications deployed on AWS by assessing them for exposure, vulnerabilities, and deviations from best practices.
expZh: Amazon Inspector 是一項自動化的安全評估服務，藉由評估部署在 AWS 上的應用程式的暴露風險、漏洞和偏離最佳實踐的情況，來協助提升其安全性和合規性。

qEn: How can a company isolate the costs of production and non-production workloads on AWS?
qZh: 一家公司如何隔離在 AWS 上生產和非生產工作負載的成本？
optionsEn: Create Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles for production and non-production workloads.
Use different accounts for production and non-production expenses.
Use Amazon EC2 for non-production workloads and other services for production workloads.
Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the use of services.
optionsZh: 為生產和非生產工作負載建立 Identity and Access Management (IAM) 角色。
為生產和非生產費用使用不同的帳戶。
將 Amazon EC2 用於非生產工作負載，將其他服務用於生產工作負載。
使用 Amazon CloudWatch 監控服務的使用情況。
expEn: The most effective and strongly recommended way to achieve strict billing isolation (as well as security isolation) between different environments like Production and Non-Production is to create completely separate AWS accounts.
expZh: 在生產和非生產等不同環境之間實現嚴格的帳單隔離（以及安全隔離），最有效且強烈建議的方法是建立完全獨立的 AWS 帳戶。

qEn: Where can users find a catalog of AWS-recognized providers of third-party security solutions?
qZh: 使用者可以在哪裡找到經 AWS 認可的第三方安全解決方案供應商目錄？
expEn: AWS Marketplace is a curated digital catalog where customers can find, buy, deploy, and manage third-party software, including a wide array of security solutions from recognized vendors.
expZh: AWS Marketplace 是一個精心策劃的數位目錄，客戶可以在此尋找、購買、部署和管理第三方軟體，包括來自認可供應商的各種安全解決方案。

qEn: A Cloud Practitioner needs to store data for 7 years to meet regulatory requirements. Which AWS service will meet this requirement at the LOWEST cost?
qZh: 雲端從業者需要儲存資料 7 年以符合法規要求。哪項 AWS 服務能以最低的成本滿足此要求？
expEn: For very long-term retention of data (like 7 years for compliance) where retrieval is infrequent and latency is acceptable, Amazon S3 Glacier (or Glacier Deep Archive) is the lowest-cost storage class.
expZh: 對於需要非常長期保留的資料（如為了合規保存 7 年），且極少需要檢索、可接受延遲的情況下，Amazon S3 Glacier（或 Glacier Deep Archive）是成本最低的儲存類別。

qEn: What are the immediate benefits of using the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
qZh: 使用 AWS 雲端的直接好處是什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Capital expenses are replaced with variable expenses.
AWS holds responsibility for security in the cloud.
optionsZh: 資本支出被變動支出取代 (Capital expenses are replaced with variable expenses)。
使用者對基礎架構的控制。
AWS 負責雲端中的安全性。
expEn: Key benefits of moving to AWS include trading large upfront Capital Expenses for variable Operational Expenses (pay-as-you-go), and increasing Agility (the ability to rapidly provision resources and innovate).
expZh: 遷移至 AWS 的主要優勢包括：將高昂的預付資本支出轉換為變動的營運支出（隨收隨付），以及提高敏捷性（快速配置資源和創新的能力）。

qEn: Which security service automatically recognizes and classifies sensitive data or intellectual property on AWS?
qZh: 哪項安全服務可自動識別並分類 AWS 上的敏感資料或智慧財產權？
expEn: Amazon Macie is a fully managed data security and data privacy service that uses machine learning and pattern matching to discover and protect your sensitive data (like PII) in Amazon S3.
expZh: Amazon Macie 是一項全託管的資料安全和資料隱私服務，它使用機器學習和模式比對來發現並保護 Amazon S3 中的敏感資料（例如 PII）。

qEn: What is the purpose of AWS Storage Gateway?
qZh: AWS Storage Gateway 的目的是什麼？
optionsEn: It ensures on-premises data storage is 99.999999999% durable.
It transports petabytes of data to and from AWS.
It connects to multiple Amazon EC2 instances.
It connects on-premises data storage to the AWS Cloud.
optionsZh: 它確保本地端資料儲存具備 99.999999999% 的耐久性。
它在 AWS 之間傳輸 PB (petabytes) 級的資料。
它連接到多個 Amazon EC2 執行個體。
它將本地端資料儲存連接至 AWS 雲端。
expEn: AWS Storage Gateway is a hybrid cloud storage service that gives you on-premises access to virtually unlimited cloud storage, effectively bridging local applications with AWS cloud storage.
expZh: AWS Storage Gateway 是一種混合雲儲存服務，讓您能在本地端存取幾乎無限的雲端儲存空間，有效地將本機應用程式與 AWS 雲端儲存橋接起來。

qEn: What should users do if they want to install an application in geographically isolated locations?
qZh: 如果使用者想要在地理上隔離的位置安裝應用程式，他們應該怎麼做？
optionsEn: Install the application using multiple internet gateways.
Deploy the application to an Amazon VPC.
Deploy the application to multiple AWS Regions.
Configure the application using multiple NAT gateways.
optionsZh: 使用多個網際網路閘道安裝應用程式。
將應用程式部署到 Amazon VPC。
將應用程式部署到多個 AWS 區域 (Regions)。
使用多個 NAT 閘道設定應用程式。
expEn: An AWS Region is a completely separate geographic area. To install an application in isolated geographic locations around the world, you must deploy it across multiple AWS Regions.
expZh: AWS 區域是一個完全獨立的地理區域。要在世界各地隔離的地理位置安裝應用程式，您必須將其部署在多個 AWS 區域。

qEn: A system in the AWS Cloud is designed to withstand the failure of one or more components. What is this an example of?
qZh: AWS 雲端中的系統被設計為能承受一個或多個組件的故障。這是什麼的範例？
optionsZh: 高可用性 (High Availability / Fault Tolerance)
expEn: Designing a system to withstand failures and remain functional (fault tolerance) is the foundational concept of achieving High Availability.
expZh: 設計一個系統以承受故障並保持正常運作（容錯）是實現高可用性的基礎概念。

qEn: A Cloud Practitioner needs a consistent and dedicated connection between AWS resources and an on-premises system. Which AWS service can fulfill this requirement?
qZh: 雲端從業者需要在 AWS 資源與本地系統之間建立穩定且專用的連線。哪項 AWS 服務能滿足此需求？
expEn: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated physical network connection from an on-premises facility to AWS. Because it does not use the public internet, it provides a highly consistent network experience.
expZh: AWS Direct Connect 提供從本地設施到 AWS 的專用實體網路連線。因為它不使用公共網際網路，所以能提供高度穩定的網路體驗。

qEn: Within the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for security and compliance?
qZh: 在 AWS 責任共擔模型內，誰負責安全和合規性？
optionsEn: AWS and the customer share responsibility.
AWS shares responsibility with the relevant governing body.
optionsZh: AWS 和客戶共同承擔責任。
AWS 與相關管理機構分擔責任。
expEn: Security and compliance is a shared responsibility between AWS and the customer. AWS is responsible for 'Security OF the Cloud', while the customer is responsible for 'Security IN the Cloud'.
expZh: 安全和合規性是 AWS 與客戶之間的共同責任。AWS 負責「雲端本身的安全」，而客戶則負責「雲端內部的安全」。

qEn: To use the AWS CLI, users are required to generate:
qZh: 要使用 AWS CLI，使用者需要產生：
optionsZh: 存取/秘密金鑰 (an access/secret key)。
expEn: To authenticate programmatic requests using the AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) or AWS SDKs, you must generate and configure an Access Key ID and a Secret Access Key for your IAM user.
expZh: 若要驗證使用 AWS 命令列介面 (CLI) 或 AWS SDK 的程式化請求，您必須為 IAM 使用者產生並設定存取金鑰 ID 和秘密存取金鑰。

qEn: Which AWS service is used to provide encryption for Amazon EBS?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務用於為 Amazon EBS 提供加密？
expEn: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) integrates directly with AWS Key Management Service (KMS) to seamlessly encrypt the data on your volumes using cryptographic keys managed by KMS.
expZh: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) 直接與 AWS Key Management Service (KMS) 整合，使用由 KMS 管理的密碼編譯金鑰無縫加密您磁碟區上的資料。

qEn: How does AWS charge for AWS Lambda usage once the free tier has been exceeded? (Choose two.)
qZh: 超過免費層級後，AWS 如何收取 AWS Lambda 用量費用？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: By the time it takes for the Lambda function to execute.
By the number of versions of a specific Lambda function.
By the number of requests made for a given Lambda function.
By the programming language that is used for the Lambda function.
By the total number of Lambda functions in an AWS account.
optionsZh: 依據 Lambda 函數執行所需的時間 (By the time it takes for the Lambda function to execute)。
依據特定 Lambda 函數的版本數量。
依據對給定 Lambda 函數提出的請求數量 (By the number of requests made for a given Lambda function)。
依據 Lambda 函數使用的程式語言。
依據 AWS 帳戶中 Lambda 函數的總數。
expEn: AWS Lambda pricing is based on two factors: the total number of requests for your functions, and the duration (the time it takes for your code to execute).
expZh: AWS Lambda 定價基於兩個因素：您函數的總請求數量，以及持續時間（執行程式碼所需的時間）。

qEn: Which of the following describes the relationships among AWS Regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations? (Choose two.)
qZh: 下列哪項描述了 AWS 區域、可用區域和邊緣站點之間的關係？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: There are more AWS Regions than Availability Zones.
There are more edge locations than AWS Regions.
An edge location is an Availability Zone.
There are more AWS Regions than edge locations.
There are more Availability Zones than AWS Regions.
optionsZh: AWS 區域的數量多於可用區域。
邊緣站點的數量多於 AWS 區域。
邊緣站點就是可用區域。
AWS 區域的數量多於邊緣站點。
可用區域的數量多於 AWS 區域。
expEn: A Region contains multiple Availability Zones, so there are more AZs than Regions. Furthermore, Edge locations (used by CloudFront globally) are far more numerous than Regions or AZs.
expZh: 一個區域包含多個可用區域，因此 AZ 的數量多於區域。此外，邊緣站點（供 CloudFront 在全球使用）的數量遠多於區域或 AZ。

qEn: What does AWS Shield Standard provide?
qZh: AWS Shield Standard 提供什麼？
optionsEn: Identity and Access Management (IAM) permissions and access to resources
optionsZh: Identity and Access Management (IAM) 權限與資源存取
expEn: AWS Shield Standard automatically provides basic Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection to all AWS customers at no additional charge.
expZh: AWS Shield Standard 自動為所有 AWS 客戶提供基本的分散式阻斷服務 (DDoS) 防護，無需額外付費。

qEn: A company wants to build its new application workloads in the AWS Cloud instead of using on-premises resources. What expense can be reduced using the AWS Cloud?
qZh: 一家公司希望在 AWS 雲端上建構其新應用程式工作負載，而不是使用本地端資源。使用 AWS 雲端可以減少什麼費用？
optionsEn: The cost of writing custom-built Java or Node .js code
hardware required to support new applications
Writing specific test cases for third-party applications.
optionsZh: 編寫客製化 Java 或 Node.js 程式碼的成本
支援新應用程式所需的硬體 (hardware required to support new applications)
為第三方應用程式編寫特定測試案例。
expEn: By moving to the AWS Cloud, companies eliminate the massive upfront capital expense of purchasing physical hardware (servers, networking gear) to support their workloads.
expZh: 透過遷移到 AWS 雲端，公司消除了購買實體硬體（伺服器、網路設備）來支援其工作負載的龐大預付資本支出。

qEn: What does AWS Marketplace allow users to do? (Choose two.)
qZh: AWS Marketplace 允許使用者做什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: Sell unused Amazon EC2 Spot Instances.
Sell solutions to other AWS users.
Buy third-party software that runs on AWS.
Purchase AWS security and compliance documents.
optionsZh: 出售未使用的 Amazon EC2 競價型執行個體。
將解決方案銷售給其他 AWS 使用者。
購買在 AWS 上執行的第三方軟體。
購買 AWS 安全和合規文件。
expEn: AWS Marketplace is a digital catalog that allows independent vendors to sell their software solutions, and allows AWS customers to find, buy, and deploy that third-party software on AWS.
expZh: AWS Marketplace 是一個數位目錄，允許獨立供應商銷售其軟體解決方案，並允許 AWS 客戶在 AWS 上尋找、購買和部署該第三方軟體。

qEn: What does it mean if a user deploys a hybrid cloud architecture on AWS?
qZh: 如果使用者在 AWS 上部署混合雲架構 (hybrid cloud architecture)，這意味著什麼？
optionsEn: All resources run using on-premises infrastructure.
Some resources run on-premises and some run in a colocation center.
All resources run in the AWS Cloud.
Some resources run on-premises and some run in the AWS Cloud.
optionsZh: 所有資源均使用本地端基礎架構執行。
部分資源在本地端執行，部分資源在主機代管中心執行。
所有資源均在 AWS 雲端中執行。
部分資源在本地端執行，部分資源在 AWS 雲端中執行。
expEn: A Hybrid architecture integrates a company's on-premises IT infrastructure with the AWS Cloud, meaning workloads and resources are distributed and communicate across both environments.
expZh: 混合架構整合了公司的本地 IT 基礎架構與 AWS 雲端，這意味著工作負載和資源分佈在這兩個環境中並跨環境通訊。

qEn: Which AWS service allows users to identify the changes made to a resource over time?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務允許使用者識別隨時間推移對資源所做的變更？
expEn: AWS Config continuously monitors and records your AWS resource configurations, allowing you to view the configuration history and changes made to a resource over time.
expZh: AWS Config 持續監控並記錄您的 AWS 資源組態設定，讓您能夠查看隨時間推移對資源所做的設定歷史記錄和變更。

qEn: How can a company reduce its Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) using AWS?
qZh: 公司如何使用 AWS 降低其總體擁有成本 (TCO)？
optionsEn: By having no responsibility for third-party license costs
optionsZh: 透過最小化龐大的資本支出 (capital expenditures)
透過對第三方授權成本不負責任
透過讓 AWS 管理應用程式
expEn: AWS allows companies to reduce TCO by replacing large upfront capital expenses (CapEx) for data centers and physical servers with lower variable operational expenses (OpEx) through a pay-as-you-go model.
expZh: AWS 允許公司透過隨收隨付模型，將資料中心和實體伺服器的高昂預付資本支出 (CapEx) 替換為較低的變動營運支出 (OpEx)，從而降低 TCO。

qEn: Which activity is a customer responsibility in the AWS Cloud according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
qZh: 根據 AWS 責任共擔模型，在 AWS 雲端中哪項活動是客戶的責任？
optionsEn: Ensuring network connectivity from AWS to the internet
Patching and fixing flaws within the AWS Cloud infrastructure
Ensuring the physical security of cloud data centers
Ensuring Amazon EBS volumes are backed up
optionsZh: 確保從 AWS 到網際網路的網路連線
修補和修復 AWS 雲端基礎架構中的缺陷
確保雲端資料中心的實體安全
確保 Amazon EBS 磁碟區已備份 (Ensuring Amazon EBS volumes are backed up)
expEn: Under 'Security IN the Cloud', the customer is responsible for managing their data, which includes implementing backup strategies (like creating EBS snapshots) to protect against data loss.
expZh: 在「雲端內部的安全」下，客戶負責管理他們的資料，這包括實施備份策略（如建立 EBS 快照）以防止資料遺失。

qEn: What are the advantages of the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
qZh: AWS 雲端的優勢是什麼？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: No need to guess capacity requirements
Physical access to cloud data centers
optionsZh: 無需猜測容量需求 (No need to guess capacity requirements)
提高上市速度 (Increased speed to market)
對雲端資料中心的實體存取
expEn: AWS Cloud advantages include 'Stop guessing capacity' (by using elasticity) and 'Increase speed and agility' (allowing organizations to innovate faster and reduce time-to-market).
expZh: AWS 雲端的優勢包括「停止猜測容量」（透過使用彈性）和「提高速度和敏捷性」（允許組織更快地創新並縮短上市時間）。

qEn: When comparing the total cost of ownership (TCO) of an on-premises infrastructure to a cloud architecture, what costs should be considered? (Choose two.)
qZh: 在比較本地基礎架構與雲端架構的總體擁有成本 (TCO) 時，應考量哪些成本？（選擇兩個）
optionsEn: The credit card processing fees for application transactions in the cloud.
The cost of purchasing and installing server hardware in the on-premises data.
The cost of administering the infrastructure, including operating system and software installations, patches, backups, and recovering from failures.
The costs of third-party penetration testing.
The advertising costs associated with an ongoing enterprise-wide campaign.
optionsZh: 雲端中應用程式交易的信用卡處理費。
在本地資料中心購買和安裝伺服器硬體的成本。
管理基礎架構的成本，包含作業系統和軟體安裝、修補程式、備份以及從故障中復原的成本。
第三方滲透測試的成本。
與進行中的企業範圍活動相關的廣告成本。
expEn: A TCO analysis compares the cost of running IT on-premises versus in the cloud. This includes comparing massive CapEx (buying physical servers) and the OpEx required to administer and maintain that physical and virtual infrastructure.
expZh: TCO 分析比較了在本地端執行 IT 與在雲端執行 IT 的成本。這包括比較龐大的 CapEx（購買實體伺服器）與管理和維護實體和虛擬基礎架構所需的 OpEx。

qEn: Which AWS feature allows a company to take advantage of usage tiers for services across multiple member accounts?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 功能允許公司跨多個成員帳戶利用服務的使用量分層 (usage tiers)？
optionsZh: 全額預付預留執行個體
expEn: Consolidated billing within AWS Organizations treats all member accounts as one single account. This allows you to combine usage across accounts to reach volume pricing tiers faster, lowering overall costs.
expZh: AWS Organizations 內的合併帳單將所有成員帳戶視為單一帳戶。這允許您合併跨帳戶的用量以更快達到數量定價級距，從而降低整體成本。

qEn: What is one of the customer's responsibilities according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
qZh: 根據 AWS 責任共擔模型，下列哪項是客戶的責任之一？
expEn: Under 'Security IN the cloud', the customer is responsible for the security of their own applications and data. The physical and core infrastructure is managed by AWS.
expZh: 在「雲端內部的安全」下，客戶負責其自有應用程式和資料的安全。實體和核心基礎架構由 AWS 管理。

qEn: What helps a company provide a lower latency experience to its users globally?
qZh: 什麼可以協助公司為其全球使用者提供較低延遲的體驗？
optionsEn: Using an AWS Region that is central to all users
Using a second Availability Zone in the AWS Region that is using used
Enabling caching in the AWS Region that is being used
Using edge locations to put content closer to all users
optionsZh: 使用對所有使用者而言位於中心的 AWS 區域
在正在使用的 AWS 區域中使用第二個可用區域
在正在使用的 AWS 區域中啟用快取
使用邊緣站點將內容放置在更靠近所有使用者的位置
expEn: Edge locations (utilized by Amazon CloudFront CDN) are distributed globally to cache content much closer to end users than Regional data centers, significantly reducing network latency.
expZh: 邊緣站點（由 Amazon CloudFront CDN 利用）分佈於全球，將內容快取在比區域資料中心更靠近終端使用者的位置，從而顯著降低網路延遲。

qEn: How can the AWS Cloud increase user workforce productivity after migration from an on-premises data center?
qZh: 從本地資料中心遷移後，AWS 雲端如何提高使用者的員工生產力？
optionsEn: Users do not have to wait for infrastructure provisioning.
The AWS Cloud infrastructure is much faster than an on-premises data center infrastructure.
AWS takes over application configuration management on behalf of users.
Users do not need to address security and compliance issues.
optionsZh: 使用者不必等待基礎架構配置 (Users do not have to wait for infrastructure provisioning)。
AWS 雲端基礎架構比本地資料中心基礎架構快得多。
AWS 代表使用者接管應用程式組態管理。
使用者不需要處理安全和合規性問題。
expEn: In the cloud, IT resources are only a click away, which means you reduce the time it takes to make those resources available to your developers from weeks to just minutes, vastly increasing agility and productivity.
expZh: 在雲端中，IT 資源只需點擊一下即可獲得，這意味著您可以將讓開發人員獲得這些資源的時間從數週縮短到只需幾分鐘，大幅提高敏捷性和生產力。

qEn: Which AWS service provides a quick and automated way to create and manage AWS accounts?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務提供快速自動化的方式來建立和管理 AWS 帳戶？
expEn: AWS Organizations allows you to centrally manage and govern your environment. You can use it to programmatically (automatically) create new AWS accounts and allocate resources.
expZh: AWS Organizations 讓您能集中管理和治理您的環境。您可以使用它以程式化（自動化）方式建立新的 AWS 帳戶並分配資源。

qEn: Which Amazon RDS feature can be used to achieve high availability?
qZh: 哪項 Amazon RDS 功能可用於實現高可用性？
optionsZh: 多可用區域 (Multiple Availability Zones / Multi-AZ)
預先配置的 IOPS (Provisioned IOPS) 儲存
expEn: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments provide high availability and failover support. RDS automatically creates a primary DB instance and synchronously replicates data to a standby instance in a different Availability Zone.
expZh: Amazon RDS 多可用區域 (Multi-AZ) 部署提供高可用性和容錯移轉支援。RDS 會自動建立主資料庫執行個體，並將資料同步複製到不同可用區域中的備用執行個體。

qEn: Where should users report that AWS resources are being used for malicious purposes?
qZh: 使用者應在哪裡報告 AWS 資源被用於惡意目的？
optionsZh: AWS 濫用團隊 (AWS Abuse team)
expEn: The AWS Trust & Safety team (also known as the Abuse team) should be contacted when AWS resources are suspected to be used for abusive or malicious purposes, such as spam or DDoS attacks.
expZh: 當懷疑 AWS 資源被用於濫用或惡意目的（如垃圾郵件或 DDoS 攻擊）時，應聯絡 AWS 信任與安全團隊（也稱為濫用團隊）。

qEn: Which AWS service needs to be enabled to track all user account changes within the AWS Management Console?
qZh: 需要啟用哪項 AWS 服務來追蹤 AWS 管理控制台內的所有使用者帳戶變更？
expEn: AWS CloudTrail records the API calls made in your account. Actions taken in the AWS Management Console are API calls, so CloudTrail tracks exactly who made changes and when.
expZh: AWS CloudTrail 記錄在您帳戶中進行的 API 呼叫。在 AWS 管理控制台中採取的動作就是 API 呼叫，因此 CloudTrail 會精確追蹤誰在何時進行了變更。

qEn: What is an AWS Cloud design best practice?
qZh: 什麼是 AWS 雲端設計最佳實踐？
expEn: Designing for High Availability (ensuring a system remains accessible in the event of failures by using multiple AZs and redundancy) is a core AWS architecture best practice.
expZh: 為高可用性進行設計（確保系統在發生故障時透過使用多個 AZ 和冗餘仍可存取）是核心的 AWS 架構最佳實踐。

qEn: Why is AWS more economical than traditional data centers for applications with varying compute workloads?
qZh: 為什麼對於運算工作負載不斷變化的應用程式，AWS 比傳統資料中心更經濟？
optionsEn: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) costs are billed on a monthly basis.
Customers retain full administrative access to their Amazon EC2 instances.
Amazon EC2 instances can be launched on-demand when needed.
Customers can permanently run enough instances to handle peak workloads.
optionsZh: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) 成本按月計費。
客戶保留對其 Amazon EC2 執行個體的完整管理員存取權限。
Amazon EC2 執行個體可以在需要時按需啟動 (Amazon EC2 instances can be launched on-demand when needed)。
客戶可以永久執行足夠的執行個體來處理尖峰工作負載。
expEn: The elasticity of AWS (launching instances on-demand when load increases and terminating them when demand drops) ensures you only pay for what you use, rather than over-provisioning permanent hardware for peak capacity in a traditional data center.
expZh: AWS 的彈性（負載增加時按需啟動執行個體，需求下降時終止它們）確保您只為使用的資源付費，而不是像在傳統資料中心那樣為尖峰容量過度配置永久硬體。

qEn: Which AWS service would simplify migration of a database to AWS?
qZh: 哪項 AWS 服務可簡化資料庫到 AWS 的遷移？
expEn: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) helps you migrate databases to AWS quickly and securely. The source database remains fully operational during the migration.
expZh: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) 協助您快速且安全地將資料庫遷移至 AWS。在遷移期間，來源資料庫仍可保持完全運作。
